description: Read the Marketo activity log — what leads actually DID or had done to them (emails sent/delivered, alerts, sales emails, campaign requests, data value changes). Start with since_datetime (ISO-8601) or continue with next_page_token. activity_type_ids is mandatory on every page (1-10 ids from list_activity_types); lead_ids is an optional server-side filter (max 30). PAGING: more_result is the only usable continuation signal here — Adobe documents that this endpoint ALWAYS returns nextPageToken, so token presence cannot terminate the loop (the opposite of get_leads/list_campaigns/list_static_lists, which ignore the vendor flag and key off the token). Page until more_result is false; Adobe states the endpoint 'can return fewer than 300 activity items while setting moreResult to true', so a short page does not mean the end of the data. ⚠ UNMEASURED: the flag's reliability on THIS endpoint has never been checked against a live instance, and the one live measurement of moreResult anywhere found it violated on list_campaigns (a full 300-record page reporting false with a usable token). If it under-reports here there is no fallback, so an activity read would truncate silently.
embedding_description: Check what actually happened to a Marketo person after a write — whether an email was sent or delivered, an alert fired, or a campaign ran — by reading activity history since a given time and paging on the vendor more-result flag until it turns false. Verifies merge, update or delete consequences after the fact; unlike get_leads it returns event history rather than current fields.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with records (a list of activity items, each carrying activityTypeId, leadId, activityDate and attributes) + row_count + spilled=false inline, OR result_blob_key + row_count + spilled=true when large, plus next_page_token and more_result. For get_activities, more_result is the only usable continuation signal — Adobe documents that the endpoint always returns a token, so the token can remain populated when the flag is false. Treat more_result as documented-but-unmeasured rather than proven: it has never been verified on this endpoint against a live instance.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with whether any NOTIFYING activity appeared (send email, email delivered, send alert, send sales email, interesting moment) — that is almost always why the caller asked. Report row_count and group the activities by activityTypeId. If more_result is true, say explicitly that the read is INCOMPLETE and next_page_token must be followed before drawing any conclusion — an empty page with more_result true means keep paging, not 'nothing happened'. Stop when more_result is false even if next_page_token remains populated; token presence alone is not a continuation signal for activities.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Never report 'no notifications were sent' unless more_result is false after the activity page chain has been drained. A partial read is not evidence of silence, and a final-page bookmark must not make paging continue forever.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Read the activity log for the configured Marketo instance to verify what a write actually caused.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.invalid_params: activity_type_ids was omitted/empty/exceeded 10, neither since_datetime nor next_page_token was supplied, since_datetime was not ISO-8601, or lead_ids exceeded 30. marketo.auth_failed: OAuth credentials rejected. marketo.permission_denied: the API user's Role lacks the Access API permission covering activity reads. marketo.partition_access_denied: the API user isn't assigned to the workspace/partition these leads live in. marketo.rate_limited: API rate limit exceeded.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: marketo.invalid_params: call list_activity_types, supply 1-10 returned ids on every page, and supply since_datetime as a full ISO-8601 instant for a fresh read or the previous next_page_token for continuation; split lead_ids into batches of 30. marketo.rate_limited: retry after a short delay and continue from the last next_page_token rather than restarting. marketo.permission_denied / marketo.partition_access_denied: run check_setup to see the exact gap and which admin screen fixes it.
